text.en: Plants and animals that earn money or protect health.

The aim is to identify plants and animals of economic importance using specimens, photographs or models.
Observe the biofertiliser Rhizobium, the medicinal plants Nilavembu and Aloe vera, the mushroom Agaricus bisporus, the indigenous cattle breed Umblachery, the Indian major carp Catla catla and the honey bees (queen and worker).
Draw a neat labelled sketch of each and write its economic importance, for example that Rhizobium fixes nitrogen and Catla catla is an important food fish.
